title: Business Requirements Document — Requirements Chat 2

sections.title: 1. Executive Summary & Strategic Rationale
sections.body: The proposed HR Management System (HRMS) is a full-stack web and mobile application designed to centralize and automate core human resources operations. The strategic rationale for this system is to replace fragmented HR processes with a unified, API-driven platform that supports end-to-end employee lifecycle management—from recruitment and onboarding to payroll, performance, and offboarding. By implementing strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and secure authentication, the system ensures data privacy and operational integrity. The platform is designed to be production-ready, scalable, and compliant with banking industry standards, providing a robust foundation for managing organizational headcount, financial payroll operations, and employee engagement.

sections.title: 2. Business Objectives & Success Metrics
sections.body:
**Business Objectives:**
1. Centralize employee master data, departments, and organizational structures.
2. Automate end-to-end workflows including recruitment, onboarding, attendance, leave, and payroll.
3. Ensure secure, role-based access for Super Admin, HR/Admin, Manager, Recruiter, Employee, and Finance/Payroll users.
4. Provide comprehensive analytics and reporting for HR, Finance, and Management.

**Success Metrics:**
- 100% coverage of core HR modules (Onboarding, Payroll, Recruitment, Performance, Offboarding).
- Successful implementation of configurable approval chains for HR, managers, finance, and admins.
- Achieve 99.99% uptime for the centralized backend API and web/mobile interfaces.
- Complete audit trail generation for all critical financial and employee data modifications.

sections.title: 3. Scope & Operational Boundaries (In/Out of Scope)
sections.body:
**In Scope:**
- **Core HR:** Employee master data, departments, designations, branches, onboarding/offboarding, profiles, document management.
- **Time & Attendance:** Attendance, shift/roster management, leave/holiday management, WFH/remote-work requests, timesheets.
- **Payroll & Finance:** Payroll processing, salary structures, deductions, bonuses, reimbursements, payslips, tax/statutory info, expense management, travel requests.
- **Recruitment:** Applicant tracking, job postings, candidate pipeline, interviews, offers, joining management.
- **Performance & Development:** Goals/KPIs, appraisals, feedback, training and learning.
- **Administration:** Asset management, grievances, announcements, notifications, policies, HR letters/certificates, surveys, self-service portals, dashboards/reports.
- **Technical Infrastructure:** Secure authentication (JWT/MFA-ready), RBAC, relational database, file storage, notification service, background jobs, logging, monitoring, encryption, backups, API integrations.

**Out of Scope:**
- The source document does not explicitly define out-of-scope items. However, specific third-party ERP integrations (beyond generic API integrations) and physical hardware procurement are not detailed in the excerpt and are considered out of scope for this initial BRD phase pending stakeholder clarification.

sections.title: 4. Key Stakeholders & Governance Personas
sections.body:
The system defines the following governance personas and stakeholders:
- **Super Admin:** Full system configuration, master-data management, and organizational settings.
- **HR/Admin:** Management of employee lifecycle, recruitment, performance, and HR policies.
- **Manager:** Approval workflows for leave, expenses, and performance reviews; team analytics.
- **Recruiter:** Management of job postings, candidate pipelines, and interview scheduling.
- **Employee:** Self-service portal for leave requests, timesheets, expense claims, and profile management.
- **Finance/Payroll:** Management of salary structures, payroll processing, deductions, and statutory compliance.

sections.title: 5. Business Requirements Specification Matrix
table: Implement JWT/session management, MFA-ready architecture, and strict Role-Based Access Control for all six defined personas.
Users can only access modules permitted by their role; MFA can be enabled/disabled per policy; JWT tokens expire correctly.
Support end-to-end workflows from Recruitment to Offboarding, including onboarding, regularization, and exit management.
An employee record can be created via recruitment, transitioned to active status, and offboarded with all associated data archived.
Manage salary structures, deductions, bonuses, reimbursements, and generate payslips with tax/statutory compliance.
Payroll runs calculate correct net pay based on configured structures; payslips are generated as PDFs; audit logs record all financial changes.
Track attendance, shifts, rosters, and manage leave/holiday requests with configurable approval chains.
Leave requests trigger notifications to managers; approved leave updates the employee's leave balance; attendance data syncs with payroll.
Manage job postings, candidate pipelines, interviews, and offer generation.
Candidates can be moved through pipeline stages; interview schedules are created; offers are generated and tracked.
Manage goals/KPIs, appraisals, feedback, and training/learning modules.
Managers can assign KPIs; employees can submit self-assessments; training completion is tracked.
Provide dashboards for headcount, attendance, attrition, payroll summaries, and department statistics.
Dashboards display real-time data; reports can be exported to Excel/CSV; filters and sorting work correctly.
Maintain immutable audit logs and activity history for all critical operations.
All create/update/delete operations on employee and financial data are logged with user ID, timestamp, and IP address; logs cannot be modified by users.

sections.title: 6. Assumptions & Operational Constraints
sections.body:
**Assumptions:**
- The system will operate on a centralized backend API with a relational database.
- Users will access the system via modern, responsive Web, Android, and iOS interfaces.
- Notification services (email/SMS/push) will be integrated with third-party providers.

**Operational Constraints:**
- **Compliance:** The system must adhere to banking industry standards, including PCI-DSS (for any payment-related data), SOX (for financial reporting integrity), AML/KYC (for identity verification in onboarding), and ISO 27001 (for information security management).
- **Security:** Data privacy, encryption at rest and in transit, and secure document access are mandatory.
- **Scalability:** The architecture must support background jobs and monitoring to handle high-volume payroll and attendance processing.

sections.title: 7. Risk & Compliance Baseline
sections.body:
**Compliance Frameworks:**
- **PCI-DSS:** Ensure any payment card data (if handled in reimbursements) is encrypted and access-restricted.
- **SOX:** Implement strict audit trails and segregation of duties for payroll and financial approvals to ensure financial reporting accuracy.
- **AML/KYC:** Integrate identity verification steps in the onboarding workflow to comply with anti-money laundering regulations.
- **ISO 27001:** Establish an information security management system (ISMS) covering risk assessment, access control, and incident response.

**NFR Benchmarks:**
- **Transaction Atomicity:** Payroll and financial transactions must be atomic to prevent partial updates.
- **Audit Immutability:** Audit logs must be tamper-proof and immutable.
- **Uptime:** The system must achieve 99.99% uptime for critical HR and payroll operations.

**Risk Mitigation:**
- Implement MFA-ready architecture to mitigate unauthorized access risks.
- Use configurable approval chains to enforce segregation of duties.
- Regular backups and monitoring to ensure data recovery and system stability.

HR Management System 
 
Build a complete HR Management System (HRMS) as a full-stack web and mobile 
application with role-based access for Super Admin, HR/Admin, Manager, Recruiter, 
Employee, and Finance/Payroll users. The system should include **secure authentication, 
role and permission management, employee master data, departments, designations, branches, 
employee onboarding/offboarding, employee profiles, document management, attendance, 
shift and roster management, leave and holiday management, work-from-home/remote-work 
requests, regularization, timesheets, payroll, salary structures, deductions, bonuses, 
reimbursements, payslips, tax/statutory information, recruitment and applicant tracking, job 
postings, candidate pipeline, interviews, offers, joining management, performance 
management, goals/KPIs, appraisals, feedback, training and learning, asset management, 
employee grievances, announcements, notifications, company policies, HR letters/certificates, 
expense management, travel requests, approval workflows, surveys, employee self-service, 
manager self-service, and comprehensive dashboards and reports. Include search, filters, 
sorting, pagination, bulk import/export, Excel/CSV upload, PDF generation, audit logs, 
activity history, configurable workflows, email/SMS/push notifications, reminders, 
calendar integration, and API integrations. The dashboard should provide HR analytics 
such as headcount, attendance, leave utilization, attrition, recruitment status, payroll 
summaries, department statistics, performance, pending approvals, and upcoming events. 
The project should have a modern responsive UI for Web, Android, and iOS, with a 
centralized backend API, relational database, file/document storage, notification service, 
background jobs, logging, monitoring, validation, encryption, backups, and strong security 
including RBAC, JWT/session management, password policies, MFA-ready architecture, 
API authorization, data privacy, audit trails, and secure document access. Define 
complete workflows such as Recruitment → Candidate Selection → Offer → Joining → 
Onboarding → Employee → Attendance/Leave → Payroll → Performance → 
Promotion/Transfer → Offboarding/Exit, with configurable approval chains for HR, 
managers, finance, and admins. Include master-data configuration, organization settings, 
financial/payroll settings, notification templates, workflow configuration, reports, audit logs, 
and system administration. The final system should be production-ready, scalable, API-
driven, well-documented, tested, and include BRD, SRS, database schema/ERD, API 
documentation, RTM, UI/UX specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria, test 
cases, deployment documentation, and complete role-wise functional requirements.
